This park also features rich forests and wetlands, under the serene skies of a Dark Sky Preserve, inviting a connection with nature and history. [![Silhouette d’une personne mi’kmaq en tenue traditionnelle, sur fond de ciel bleu.](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/WET-2022/ria-640.jpg?modified=20250205143627)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/info/gouvernance-governance) ### [Mi'gmaw connections](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/info/gouvernance-governance) Towards shared governance of Parks Canada places in New Brunswick [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/WET-2022/conserv/conservation-06-640.jpg?modified=00010101000000)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/nature) ### [Nature and science](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/nature) Conservation and recovery of species at risk and their habitats. | | ### Contact us **Phone** [506‑876‑2443](tel:506-876-2443) **Email** [kouchibouguac@pc.gc.ca](mailto:kouchibouguac@pc.gc.ca) **Complete address** [How to reach us](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/visit) ### Hours of operation **Open year-round** Visitor services available from January to October [Check our hours of operation](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/visit/heures-hours) ### Social - [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/KouchibouguacNP) ## More places to discover with Parks Canada [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nb/fundy-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220756)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/fundy) ### [Fundy National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/fundy) The world’s highest tides await visitors at Fundy National Park. Kayak on the Bay of Fundy, explore the seafloor when the tide recedes, hike or bike through native Acadian forests and more at one of Canada’s best-known national parks. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nb/boishebert-640x320.jpg?modified=20221126220756)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nb/boishebert) ### [Boishébert and Beaubears Island Shipbuilding National Historic Sites](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nb/boishebert) Uncover the trials and triumphs of centuries past. Connect with history on a Voyageur Canoe adventure. Interact with lively historical recreationists. Stroll through old-growth pines and discover the captivating stories of Boishébert and Beaubears National Historic Sites. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nb/Beausejour-640x320.jpg?modified=20221126220756)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nb/beausejour) ### [Fort Beauséjour – Fort Cumberland National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nb/beausejour) Discover a time when Britain and France were caught in a tug-of-war for dominance in Acadie, and be moved by the stories of soldiers and settlers who lived and died around the historic star-shaped fort. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nb/MonumentLefebvre-640x320.jpg?modified=20221126220757)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nb/lefebvre) ### [Monument Lefebvre National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nb/lefebvre) The Monument-Lefebvre is a 19th century heritage building where visitors experience the triumphs of the Acadians through artefacts, film, performances, and the permanent exhibit, “Reflections of a Journey – The Odyssey of the Acadian People.” [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/qc/qc-bataille-ristigouche-lhn-nhs-2-640x360.jpg?modified=00010101000000)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/qc/ristigouche) ### [Battle of Restigouche National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/qc/ristigouche) Relive the last naval battle between France and England for possession of American territory. As well, discover the remains of the wreck of the Machault which has been under water for over 200 years! Follow an employee in period costume so you don't miss out on any of the history! [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nb/Beaubassin-640x320.jpg?modified=20221126220756)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/ns/beaubassin) ### [Beaubassin and Fort Lawrence National Historic Sites](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/ns/beaubassin) A thriving Acadian settlement here became a pivotal site in the struggle between Great Britain and France for control of the Isthmus of Chignecto region. # Camping and overnight accommodations

## Kouchibouguac National Park

[Reserve online at **reservation.pc.gc.ca**](https://reservation.pc.gc.ca/) [Reserve by phone by calling **1-877-737-3783**](tel:18777373783)

* * *

Camping has always been a very popular activity in Kouchibouguac National Park. Campers appreciate the privacy and the feeling of tranquility the Kouchibouguac campsites provide.

## Campgrounds

### [South Kouchibouguac](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/activ/camping/south)

311 campsites with amenities including washrooms with showers, playgrounds and dumping station.

### [Côte-à-Fabien](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/activ/camping/fabien)

34 unserviced sites, located along a lagoon near Loggiecroft wharf and Osprey hiking trail.

### [Backcountry camping](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/activ/camping/arrierepays-backcountry)

3 backcountry camping locations, with fire pits, picnic tables and pit toilets.

## Roofed accommodations

### [oTENTik](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/activ/camping/oTENTik)

A spacious blend of tent and rustic cabin equipped with beds and furniture on a raised floor.

### A few rules

- Don't move firewood! [Importing firewood is prohibited](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/nature/bois-wood)
- [Pets](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nb/kouchibouguac/visit/animaux-pets) must be kept on a leash at all times
- It is illegal to feed wildlife in national parks
- Keep your campsite clean, animals are attracted by human food and waste
- Excessive noise will not be tolerated, day or night
- Quiet time is from 11 pm to 7 am
